description: This file defines a custom NSView subclass and a SwiftUI wrapper for highlighting menu items in a Mac application, managing hover states and visual updates.

classes.name: HighlightedMenuItemHostView
classes.description: A custom NSView that displays a highlighted menu item, handling hover state, layout, and appearance.

methods.name: init(rootView:width:)
methods.description: Initializes the HighlightedMenuItemHostView with a SwiftUI view and a specified width.

methods.name: update(rootView:width:)
methods.description: Updates the rootView and width of the view, refreshing highlight states.
